articles.title: What happens when AI starts building AI? Anthropic explains | Technology News - The Indian Express
articles.rephrased_article: Anthropic, an AI frontier lab, warns that the rapid pace of AI development could lead to a future where AI systems autonomously design and develop their own successors. This phenomenon, known as recursive self-improvement (RSI), is not inevitable but could occur sooner than anticipated. While current AI systems demonstrate advanced coding and problem-solving abilities, they are not yet capable of fully autonomous redesigning and creating superior successors without human intervention. Anthropic emphasizes the need for control mechanisms to ensure alignment with human goals and prevent unintended consequences as AI systems become increasingly sophisticated.  The company suggests international cooperation and verification mechanisms similar to arms-control agreements to address potential risks associated with RSI.

articles.title: Can pending case prevent foreign trip? Court defends doctor’s right to travel | Legal News - The Indian Express
articles.rephrased_article: The Andhra Pradesh High Court ruled that the denial of a cardiologist's passport renewal application due to pending criminal proceedings was unjustified. The court cited previous rulings upholding the right to travel abroad and stressed that restrictions on travel must meet legal requirements for fairness, reasonableness, and legality. The court directed the Regional Passport Officer to renew the doctor's passport in accordance with these principles.
